Once favored by the knights at Hyrule Castle.|Inventory|TotK}}{{Cite|'''Knight's Bow'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 26 |durability = 48 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Knight's Bow}} Knight's Bows are [[Bow]]s that were once favored by the [[Hylian Knight]]s who defended [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. Their metal construction grants them a superior durability, and they are known to be reliable while firing. Commonly, they are used by many [[Enemy|Enemies]] in the [[Gerudo Desert]] and [[Tabantha Frontier]]. The following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Knight's Bow when they are scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]: * {{SSB}} Series [[Princess Zelda]] amiibo * {{BotW}} Series [[Link]] (Archer) amiibo Being made of metal, Knight's Bows will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped outdoors during a [[Thunderstorm]]. In addition, they sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] Rune. They also do not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Knight's Bows belong to the [[Knight's Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} Many of the [[Weapon]]s in this grouping were used by the Hylian Knights prior to the [[Great Calamity]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_035" |Life = 48 |Power = 26 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 0 |LeadShotAng = 45.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Knight's Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 26 |durability = |flammable = No |magnetic = |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = }} Knight's Bows are set to reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bow * Knight's Gear }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bows, Knight's Gear, Weapons |items= BotW, TotK }}
